title: Giraffe holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- giraffe body -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='64' rx='20' ry='14' fill='#F2B33D'/>
  <!-- spots on body -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='60' r='3' fill='#C97A1E'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='66' r='3.5' fill='#C97A1E'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='58' r='3' fill='#C97A1E'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='34' y='74' width='5' height='17' rx='2' fill='#E0A030'/>
  <rect x='44' y='75' width='5' height='16' rx='2' fill='#F2B33D'/>
  <rect x='53' y='74' width='5' height='17' rx='2' fill='#E0A030'/>
  <rect x='60' y='75' width='5' height='16' rx='2' fill='#F2B33D'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='34' y='89' width='5' height='3' rx='1' fill='#8B5A1E'/>
  <rect x='44' y='89' width='5' height='3' rx='1' fill='#8B5A1E'/>
  <rect x='53' y='89' width='5' height='3' rx='1' fill='#8B5A1E'/>
  <rect x='60' y='89' width='5' height='3' rx='1' fill='#8B5A1E'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <path d='M60 60 L66 26 L76 26 L70 60 Z' fill='#F2B33D'/>
  <!-- neck spots -->
  <circle cx='66' cy='40' r='2.6' fill='#C97A1E'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='50' r='2.6' fill='#C97A1E'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='32' r='2.4' fill='#C97A1E'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='73' cy='20' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#F2B33D'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='82' cy='21' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#E8A83C'/>
  <!-- ossicones -->
  <rect x='68' y='10' width='2.5' height='5' rx='1' fill='#C97A1E'/>
  <rect x='74' y='10' width='2.5' height='5' rx='1' fill='#C97A1E'/>
  <circle cx='69.2' cy='9.5' r='2' fill='#8B5A1E'/>
  <circle cx='75.2' cy='9.5' r='2' fill='#8B5A1E'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='16' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#E0A030' transform='rotate(-25 64 16)'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='75' cy='18' r='1.8' fill='#3B2410'/>
  <circle cx='75.6' cy='17.4' r='0.6' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- nostril -->
  <circle cx='84' cy='21.5' r='1' fill='#8B5A1E'/>
  <!-- front leg holding balloon string -->
  <rect x='66' y='55' width='5' height='14' rx='2' fill='#F2B33D'/>
  <rect x='66' y='67' width='5' height='3' rx='1' fill='#8B5A1E'/>
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M68.5 55 Q62 45 58 34' stroke='#F5F5F5' stroke-width='1' fill='none'/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='24' rx='9' ry='11' fill='#E84A5F'/>
  <ellipse cx='53' cy='20' rx='2.5' ry='3.5' fill='#FF8A98'/>
  <!-- balloon knot -->
  <path d='M56 35 L54 38 L58 38 Z' fill='#C83248'/>
</svg>
